page_title: VIL 2-0 OVI | Villarreal v Oviedo 15/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Alejandro Ruiz due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) and his team.
90+5' Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) hammers the ball towards the left side of the goal, but it's not so easy to put it behind Junior Reis, who denies him with a terrific save.
90+4' The referee blows his whistle after Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
90+3' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Borja Sanchez (R. Oviedo) plays a lovely through ball to Federico Vinas, but he can't beat Junior Reis and loses the ball.
88' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) tries to find Tajon Buchanan, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
86' The ratio of the ball possession is 70:30.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rahim Alhassane departs the field of play to be replaced by Santi Cazorla (R. Oviedo).
82' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thomas Partey (Villarreal) replacing Santi Comesana.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) comes onto the pitch so that Nicolas Pepe can be given a rest.
81' Etta Eyong (Villarreal) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
80' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes it short.
80' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Aaron Escandell.
79' Villarreal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
77' Veljko Paunovic has decided to substitute Ilyas Chaira and he is replaced by Omar Falah (R. Oviedo).
77' Luka Ilic goes off the pitch and Borja Sanchez (R. Oviedo) comes on.
75' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
74' The attendance is 18333.
74' Aaron Escandell displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
73' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
71' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
70' Here is a change. Pape Gueye is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
70' Here's the change. Juan Foyth leaves the pitch and Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.
69' Referee Alejandro Ruiz has finally had enough of Veljko Paunovic and brandishes a yellow card at him!
69' The game is interrupted. Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

68' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) produces a brilliant low pass into the box, where Pape Gueye is already waiting. He attempts to dribble past the defence, but one of the defenders does well to dispossess him.
65' Etta Eyong (Villarreal) attempts to release Nicolas Pepe with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
63' That's the end of the game for Salomon Rondon, who is replaced by Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo).
62' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
61' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
60' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
59' Nicolas Pepe sprays a pass out to Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar.

58' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Villarreal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
55' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) sends a rebound goalwards, low to the left-hand post, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it.
54' Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Junior Reis stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
53' Etta Eyong (Villarreal) is penalised for a foul. Alejandro Ruiz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
52' Aaron Escandell displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Etta Eyong (Villarreal) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
51' Villarreal are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
49' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
48' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
47' Gerard Moreno is substituted due to injury. Marcelino gives a chance to Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).
46' Veljko Paunovic makes a switch. Marco Esteban (R. Oviedo) is coming on in place of Haissem Hassan at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
45+3' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+2' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' He should have scored! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Aaron Escandell makes an easy save.
44' Nacho Vidal (R. Oviedo) is caught offside!
44' A pass into the penalty area from Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is intercepted by the defence.
42' Villarreal take a short corner kick.
41' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
41' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
40' Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
39' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Ruiz signals a foul.
36' 2 - 0 Goal! Nicolas Pepe plays a short, square pass into the path of Pape Gueye (Villarreal), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 2:0. Fabulous goal!
35' The rebound finds Etta Eyong (Villarreal) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
34' The corner from Pape Gueye (Villarreal) is intercepted by the defence.
33' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
31' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
29' 1 - 0 Etta Eyong (Villarreal) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the bottom left corner, and thus alter the score to 1:0.
29' The ball is out of play and Villarreal manage to earn a corner.
28' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.

27' Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Alejandro Ruiz shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
25' Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) plays a one-two with Luka Ilic, but the move breaks down.
23' Rafa Marin (Villarreal) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
23' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Villarreal.
22' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) sends the corner into the box, but Aaron Escandell intercepts it and averts the threat.
22' Aaron Escandell pulls off a great save to deny Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
20' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Aaron Escandell stops the ball from going inside right post.
19' Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar.
18' R. Oviedo will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
18' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
18' It's like he was asking for a caution. Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) receives a yellow card.
17' Etta Eyong (Villarreal) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
16' The cross into the penalty area from Santi Comesana (Villarreal) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
14' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) misses the penalty after the goalkeeper anticipates the direction of the shot and makes an excellent save!
14' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) is going to take the penalty!
13' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Junior Reis (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
12' PENALTY to R. Oviedo! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
11' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.

11' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
10' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Aaron Escandell sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
10' Aaron Escandell is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Etta Eyong (Villarreal). Easy save!
9' Villarreal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
9' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
7' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) and Alberto Reina attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
5' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
5' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Villarreal.
5' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pape Gueye (Villarreal).
4' Aaron Escandell displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Pape Gueye (Villarreal) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
3' Yeremy Pino sends a lofted pass into the box, Santi Comesana (Villarreal) shows good awareness to connect with it but blazes his shot high over the crossbar.
2' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
